name: gramophone
description: A vinyl music player that reads the melody, hooks, key and tempo of your songs and plays them on a spinning record.
author: Hex (https://github.com/RealMrHex)

scripts.android: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.android:run: npm run android && npx cap run android
